reasons.plausibility: Mo is known to partition to BCC and form intermetallics in AlCoCrFeNi systems, which typically increases strength but reduces ductility, contradicting the claim of simultaneous improvement of both properties.
reasons.testability: The proposed test (tensile testing and microstructural analysis) is straightforward and would clearly falsify the hypothesis if strength and ductility do not both improve.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a relevant alloy but ignores the specific application requirements (creep, corrosion, thermal stability) and proposes a well-known, likely detrimental modification without mechanistic depth.
